paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni khat Saul tapa Jonathan in agalvan tawipa tangval kiang ah, "Kisa dih, gal langkhat a Philistia mi galvil sepaihte omna ah i va hoh ding," achi hi. Himahleh apa ahilh kei hi.
heading: Jonathan Thilhih Hangsan
english: Now it happened on a day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the Philistines’ garrison that is on the other side.” But he didn’t tell his father.

paite: Saul bel Gibeah gam tawp lam pek a Migron a theibuhfai kung nuai ah a-om hi. Akiang a om mite zaguk ahi uh.
english: Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron; and the people who were with him were about six hundred men,

paite: Shiloh a TOUPA siampu Eli tapa Phinehas tapa Ikabod unaupa Ahitub tapa Ahijah siampu puanak silh a-om hi. Jonathan ahoh chih mipite'n athei kei uhi.
english: including Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of Yahweh in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. The people didn’t know that Jonathan was gone.

paite: Jonathan in Philistia mi galvil sepaihte omna a hoh atupna phaizang leh phaizang kikal ah alang tuaktuak ah suangpi sangtak a-om hi. Akhat min Bozez ahi a, akhat min Seneh ahi.
english: Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines’ garrison, there was a rocky crag on the one side and a rocky crag on the other side; and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

paite: Suangpi sang khat pen Mikmash zawn mallam a om ahi a, adang khat pen Gebeah zawn simlam a om ahi.
english: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.

paite: Jonathan in agalvan tawipa tangval kiang ah, "Kisa dih, zeksum louh sepaihte omna ah i va hoh ding. TOUPA'N thil ahon hihsak kha mai hiam. TOUPA a ding in atam hiam, atawm hiam ahotdamna ding bangmah dalna a-om tuan ngal kei a," achi hi.
english: Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may be that Yahweh will work for us, for there is no restraint on Yahweh to save by many or by few.”

paite: Agalvan tawipa'n akiang ah, "Na lungsim a om bangtak in hih in. Ngai in, na lungsim bang geih ka lungsim ahi," achi hi.
english: His armor bearer said to him, “Do all that is in your heart. Go, and behold, I am with you according to your heart.”

paite: Huchi in Jonathan in, "Kisa in, akiang uah i va hoh galkah dia, i va kimusak ding.
english: Then Jonathan said, “Behold, we will pass over to the men, and we will reveal ourselves to them.

paite: I kiang a, 'Na kiang ua ka hong matan uh na om un, ahon chih uleh i mun ah i dingh kinken dia, akiang uah i hohtou kei ding.'
english: If they say this to us, ‘Wait until we come to you!’ then we will stand still in our place and will not go up to them.

paite: "Ka kiang lam uah hong tou un, achih uleh bel i hohtou dia, TOUPA'N i khut ah amaute ahon pia chih ei a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding," achi hi.
english: But if they say this, ‘Come up to us!’ then we will go up, for Yahweh has delivered them into our hand. This shall be the sign to us.”

paite: Anih un Philistia mi galvil sepaihte ava kimusak uhi. Philistiate'n, "En dih uh, Hebru mite abukna leihawm a pan ahong paikhia uh," achi uhi.
english: Both of them revealed themselves to the garrison of the Philistines; and the Philistines said, “Behold, the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they had hidden themselves!”

paite: Galvil sepaihte omna a mite'n Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa, "Hong paitou unla, thil banghiam ka hon ensak ding uh," chi in ana sam uhi. Jonathan in agalvan tawipa kiang ah, "Hon zuitou dih. TOUPA'N amaute Israelte khut ah apeta hi," achi hi.
english: The men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armor bearer, and said, “Come up to us, and we will show you something!” Jonathan said to his armor bearer, “Come up after me, for Yahweh has delivered them into the hand of Israel.”

paite: Jonathan akhut leh khe toh pang in akaltou a, agalvan tawipa'n azui hi. Amau bel Jonathan ma ah apuk ua, ama nung in agalvan tawipa'n amaute athat hi.
english: Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet, and his armor bearer after him, and they fell before Jonathan; and his armor bearer killed them after him.

paite: Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa'n athah masakpen uh mi sawmnih vel, lou chiing khat, bawngtal nih leilehna chia sung ahi.
english: That first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armor bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow’s length in an acre of land.

paite: Giahmun leh gamlak a mipi tengteng aling ua; galvil sepaihte leh lok mite leng aling sam uh. Huan ziin ahong ling a; huchi in nakpitak a linna a-om hi.
english: There was a trembling in the camp, in the field, and among all the people; the garrison and the raiders also trembled; and the earth quaked, so there was an exceedingly great trembling.

paite: Benjamin gam Gibeah ah Saul galvil mite'n a-en vialvial uhi. Ngai in, mipite zul in azulkhe zungzung ua, khat lam khat lam ah akiphutuah muimui uhi.
heading: Philistiate Tung A Vualzohna
english: The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and behold, the multitude melted away and scattered.

paite: Huchi in Saul in akiang a mipi omte kiang ah, "Tu in kisim unla, kuate ahia kim lou hong ki-en dih ua," achi hi. Ahong kisim uleh ngai in, Jonathan leh agalvan tawipa ana om kei uhi.
english: Then Saul said to the people who were with him, “Count now, and see who is missing from us.” When they had counted, behold, Jonathan and his armor bearer were not there.

paite: Saul in Ahijah kiang ah, "Pathian bawm va la dih," achi hi. Huai lai in Pathian bawm Israel suante kiang a om ahi.
english: Saul said to Ahijah, “Bring God’s ark here.” For God’s ark was with the children of Israel at that time.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul in siampu ahoupih laitak in Philistia mite giahmun lam a thawmging angaih semsem hi. Saul in siampu kiang ah, "Na khut kaikik in," achi hi.
english: While Saul talked to the priest, the tumult that was in the camp of the Philistines went on and increased; and Saul said to the priest, “Withdraw your hand!”

paite: Huchi in Saul leh akiang a mipi om tengteng apaikhawm ua, kidouna ah ahohta uh. Ngai in, amau leh amau namsau in ana kisattuah ua, huchi in apumbuai uhi.
english: Saul and all the people who were with him were gathered together, and came to the battle; and behold, they were all striking each other with their swords in very great confusion.

paite: Hiai ban ah tuma lam a Hebru mite huai gam kim a pan Philistiate giahmun a amau toh va paitoute leng Saul leh Jonathan kiang a om in Israel mite lam ah ahong pang nawnta uhi,
english: Now the Hebrews who were with the Philistines before and who went up with them into the camp from all around, even they also turned to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

paite: Huchi mah bang in Ephraim tanggam a Israel mi kibu tengteng in Philistia mite ataimang uh chih ana za ua, amau leng kidouna a pang sam in adelhzui uhi.
english: Likewise all the men of Israel who had hidden themselves in the hill country of Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.

paite: Huchi in huai ni in TOUPA'N Israelte ahumbitta hi. Beth-aven pha in asual uhi.
english: So Yahweh saved Israel that day; and the battle passed over by Beth Aven.

paite: Huai ni in Israel mite alungkia ua, Saul in, "Ka melmate tung a phu ka lakna dia nitaklam ahih masiah kuapeuh in an anekleh hamsia thuak hen," achih ziak in. Huchi in kuamah in an himhim achiam kei uhi.
heading: Kidou Khit A Thil Tungte
english: The men of Israel were distressed that day; for Saul had adjured the people, saying, “Cursed is the man who eats any food until it is evening, and I am avenged of my enemies.” So none of the people tasted food.

paite: Mipi tengteng gamnuai ava tung ua, lei ah khuaizu ana om hi.
english: All the people came into the forest; and there was honey on the ground.

paite: Mipite gamnuai ava tun un, ngai in, khuaizu ana takkhia hi. Himahleh mipite'n hamsia alauh ziak un kuama'n khut a sawk in achiam ngam kei uhi.
english: When the people had come to the forest, behold, honey was dripping, but no one put his hand to his mouth, for the people feared the oath.

paite: Himahleh apa'n mipite kichiam a, vau ahih lam Jonathan in thei lou in akhut a chiangmong in khuaikhak adawt a, akam a guang in aneta a, huchi in amit hah ahong chiangta hi.
english: But Jonathan didn’t hear when his father commanded the people with the oath. Therefore he put out the end of the rod that was in his hand and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.

paite: Mipi lak a mi khat in ahoupih a, "Na pa'n zaw mipite tuni a an ne peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen, chi a vau bikbek hiven. Huchi in mipite abah uhi,” achi hi.
english: Then one of the people answered, and said, “Your father directly commanded the people with an oath, saying, ‘Cursed is the man who eats food today.’” So the people were faint.

paite: Jonathan in, "Ka pa'n mite buaisak lel ahi ve. Enta unla, khuaizu tawmchik ka chep ziak lel a ka mit ahong vak takdan.
english: Then Jonathan said, “My father has troubled the land. Please look how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.

paite: Mipite'n gallak thil amuh peuhpeuh uh tuni in a-utut uh ne thei le uh vakzaw na tel in chia! Huaiziak in Philistiate tamsem thah louh loh i hi ve ua,” achi hi.
english: How much more, if perhaps the people had eaten freely today of the plunder of their enemies which they found? For now there has been no great slaughter among the Philistines.”

paite: Huai ni in Mikmash a pan Aijalon tan in Philistia mite adou uh. Huchi in mipite abah mahmah uhi.
english: They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint;

paite: Mipite'n agallak thil uh aboh in aboh uhi. Belamte, bawngtalte leh bawngnoute aman ua, leitual ah athat ua, mipite'n asisan toh ane uhi.
heading: Israel Mite Khelhna
english: and the people pounced on the plunder, and took sheep, cattle, and calves, and killed them on the ground; and the people ate them with the blood.

paite: "Ngai in, mipite'n sisan toh ne in TOUPA tung ah akhialta uh," chi in Saul ahilh uhi. Ama'n, "Na talekta uhi; ka ma ah suang lianpi khuk un," achi hi.
english: Then they told Saul, saying, “Behold, the people are sinning against Yahweh, in that they eat meat with the blood.” He said, “You have dealt treacherously. Roll a large stone to me today!”

paite: Saul in, "Mipi lak ah vakzak vek unla, akiang uah, michih in abawng hon kai hen. Michih in abelam hon kai hen. Hiai ah hong gou in ne hen. Asisan toh ne a TOUPA tung a thil hihkhial lou in, va chi un," achi hi. Huai zan in mi tengteng in amau bawngtal chiat uh ahon kai ua, huai ah agou uhi.
english: Saul said, “Disperse yourselves among the people, and tell them, ‘Every man bring me here his ox, and every man his sheep, and kill them here, and eat; and don’t sin against Yahweh in eating meat with the blood.’” All the people brought every man his ox with him that night, and killed them there.

paite: Saul in TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a; huai pen TOUPA a dia maitam abawl masakpen ahi.
english: Saul built an altar to Yahweh. This was the first altar that he built to Yahweh.

paite: Saul in, "Zan chiang in Philistia mite va dou unla, zing khovak tan in i sual ding uh. Kuamah i hawi kei ding uh," achi hi. Amau, "Hoih na sak peuhmah hih in," achi uh. Siampu in ahihleh, "Pathian naih ni," achi hi.
english: Saul said, “Let’s go down after the Philistines by night, and take plunder among them until the morning light. Let’s not leave a man of them.” They said, “Do whatever seems good to you.” Then the priest said, “Let’s draw near here to God.”

paite: Saul in Pathian adong a, "Philistia mite ka va sual diam? Israelte khut ah amaute na pe diam?" achi hi. Himahleh huai ni'n adawng kei.
english: Saul asked counsel of God: “Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will you deliver them into the hand of Israel?” But he didn’t answer him that day.

paite: Saul in, "Nou mipi heutu tengteng hong nai dih ua. Tuni in akoi pen ah ahia i khelh uh theihkhiak tum dih uh.
english: Saul said, “Draw near here, all you chiefs of the people, and know and see in whom this sin has been today.

paite: Israelte hondam zelpa TOUPA ahin lai teng ka tapa Jonathan hilhial in ana hihkhelhleh amah asih ngeingei ding ahi,” achi hi. Himahleh mipi lak a mi kuamah adawng himhim a-om kei uh.
english: For as Yahweh lives, who saves Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die.” But there was not a man among all the people who answered him.

paite: Israel tengteng kiang ah, "Noute atuam in omkhawm unla, kei leh ka tapa Jonathan atuam in ka omkhawm ding uh," achi hi. Mipite'n Saul kiang ah, "Hoih na sak bang in hih in," achi uhi.
english: Then he said to all Israel, “You be on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side.” The people said to Saul, “Do what seems good to you.”

paite: Saul in TOUPA Israelte' Pathian kiang ah, "Adiktak hon hihlang in," achi a, aisan pen Jonathan leh Saul tung ah apuk a; mipite bel ahul uhi.
english: Therefore Saul said to Yahweh, the God of Israel, “Show the right.” Jonathan and Saul were chosen, but the people escaped.

paite: Saul in, "Kei leh ka tapa kikal ah aisan un," achi hi. Huchi in Jonathan tung ah apuk hi.
english: Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.

paite: Saul in Jonathan kiang ah, "Bang ahia na hih hon hilh in," achi hi. Jonathan in ahilh a, "Ka chiang tawi mong in khuaizu neuchik ka na chiam hi. Ngai in, ka sih ding mah ahi," achi hi.
english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done!” Jonathan told him, and said, “I certainly did taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand; and behold, I must die.”

paite: Saul in, "Pathian in ahihhih in hih mai hen. Huai sang a thupizaw in leng. Jonathan, na si ngeingei ding ahi," achi hi.
english: Saul said, “God do so and more also; for you shall surely die, Jonathan.”

paite: Mipite'n Saul kiang ah, "Israelte lak a hiai hotdamna thupi mahmah hihpa Jonathan asi dia hia? Si lou hial ding. TOUPA ahin lai teng asamzang khat leng lei ah ake het kei ding. Tuni in Pathian toh asemkhawm uhi," achi uh. Mipite'n Jonathan ahondam ua, asi kei hi.
english: The people said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, who has worked this great salvation in Israel? Far from it! As Yahweh lives, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground, for he has worked with God today!” So the people rescued Jonathan, so he didn’t die.

paite: Saul in Philistia mite adelh lai akiksanta a, Philistia mite amau om mun ah apaita uhi.
english: Then Saul went up from following the Philistines; and the Philistines went to their own place.

paite: Saul in Israelte tung ah vaihawmna ala a, aning teng ah amelmate, Moab, Ammon suante, Edom, Zobah kumpipate leh Philistia mite adou a; akiheina peuh ah avualzou zel hi.
heading: Saul Vaihawmna Leh Inkuante
english: Now when Saul had taken the kingdom over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side: against Moab, and against the children of Ammon, and against Edom, and against the kings of Zobah, and against the Philistines. Wherever he turned himself, he defeated them.

paite: Hangsantak in gal adou a, Amalekte azou a, alok mite khut a pan Israelte ahonkhia hi.
english: He did valiantly and struck the Amalekites, and delivered Israel out of the hands of those who plundered them.

paite: Saul tapate bel Jonathan, Ishvi leh Malki-shua ahi ua, atanu nihte min hiaite ahi; a-upazaw min Merab ahi a, anaupangzaw min Mikal ahi.
english: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.

paite: Saul zi min Ahinoam ahi a, amah Ahimaaz tanu ahi. Asepaih heutu min Abner ahi a, amah Saul paneu Ner tapa ahi.
english: The name of Saul’s wife was Ahinoam the daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the captain of his army was Abner the son of Ner, Saul’s uncle.

paite: Saul pa Kish ahi a, Abner pa Ner bel Abiel tapa ahi.
english: Kish was the father of Saul, and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

paite: Saul damsung teng in Philistia mite toh nakpitak in akidou uhi. Saul in mihat leh hangsan amuh peuhmah anuai a sem ding in ala zel hi.
english: There was severe war against the Philistines all the days of Saul; and when Saul saw any mighty man or any valiant man, he took him into his service.
